purpose: Generated projection of distributed Styio syntax-feature SSOT documents, their lifecycle states, dependencies, prerequisites, implementation owners, and golden evidence.

features.title: Affine Capturing Closures
features.syntax: Place the explicit `$(name, ...)` capture list between a callable signature and its binding/body operator, for example `# add : i64 $(seed) := (value: i64) => value + seed`; no lifetime, copy, heap, or ownership keyword is introduced.
features.resolution: Derive shared-borrow, exclusive-borrow, or consume facts from each captured use; lower the proven scalar slice to one program-static environment; permit shared-borrow escape, keep exclusive-borrow environments direct-call-only, and reject consume or representation/drop gaps before lowering.

features.title: Ambiguous Literal Defaulting
features.syntax: Ordinary numeric and collection literals; no callable type-argument syntax.
features.resolution: Never default empty collections; normalize numeric literals to the canonical scalar-width contract and default unresolved numeric-only variables once in a final expression-local phase.

features.title: Callable Binding
features.syntax: # name = #(arg: T) => expr, # name := (arg: T) => expr, and block-bodied callable forms
features.resolution: Use `#` to mark callable identity while reusing `=` and `:=` for mutable and final binding.

features.title: Callable Interface Scheme Publication
features.syntax: Existing callable export/import forms; no authored generic interface syntax proposed.
features.resolution: Publish the canonical scheme and canonical effect/capability contract separately from the portable typed-body payload owned by core.portable-generic-body-interface; downstream units specialize, and cross-module recursive SCCs are rejected.

features.title: Callable Specialization Policy
features.syntax: No source-level explicit-instantiation syntax proposed.
features.resolution: Collect only reachable instances, assign deterministic single-owner symbols, key reuse by canonical semantic and backend digests, and fail closed at recursive or pathological growth ceilings.

features.title: Canonical Effect Rows
features.syntax: No new source form; canonical effect rows are compiler-owned scheme, diagnostic, typed-IR, and `.styioi` facts.
features.resolution: Replace the closed bit-summary identity with a canonical row of known labels plus an optional compiler-owned open tail for higher-order relations; keep native unknown effects fail-closed and do not accept source assertions.

features.title: Capability-Polymorphic Handles
features.syntax: No new source form proposed; this decision governs the universe of inferred relation variables.
features.resolution: Generalized variables admit plain immutable scalar values and pure materialized collections only; resource, stream, task, matrix, and ownership-sensitive handles remain monomorphic.

features.title: Capability and Usage Polymorphism
features.syntax: No authored lifetime, capability, multiplicity, or shape variable; all usage/capability facts are compiler-owned relation metadata.
features.resolution: Admit capability-sensitive relation variables only through closed compiler-owned copy/borrow/consume, task-transfer, resource-state-family, and materialized-shape facts, with each family enabled separately and revalidated against topology at every concrete instance.

features.title: Conditional Expression
features.syntax: ?(cond) => expr | fallback and block-bodied conditionals
features.resolution: Use the symbol-headed `?()` guard family for value and block conditionals.

features.title: Constrained Callable Relations
features.syntax: No source constraint syntax; constraints are inferred from ordinary expressions.
features.resolution: Infer a closed compiler-owned constraint vocabulary from ordinary expressions; do not add user-defined traits, instances, or source constraint syntax.

features.title: Context-Driven Call Instantiation
features.syntax: identity(value) with an optional concrete expected type supplied by the enclosing expression
features.resolution: Instantiate inferred relations from ordinary argument types and the enclosing concrete expected type; reject unresolved variables and never parse authored call-site type arguments.

features.title: Effect-Aware Callable Generalization
features.syntax: No new source syntax proposed; this decision governs eligibility of final callable bindings for generalization.
features.resolution: Generalize only closed, proven-pure final callable bodies; unknown or effectful bodies remain monomorphic, with canonical effect identity owned by the extending core.canonical-effect-rows feature.

features.title: Expression Precedence
features.syntax: arithmetic, comparison, boolean, call, index, member, and parenthesized expressions
features.resolution: Keep one compiler-owned expression hierarchy with call, index, and member postfix forms binding above infix operators.

features.title: Final And Mutable Binding
features.syntax: name := expr, name = expr, name: T := expr
features.resolution: Use `:=` for final bindings and `=` for mutable bindings, with optional type annotations resolved in type position.

features.title: Fixed Inference Defaults
features.syntax: No default declaration or project/module configuration form; explicit scalar and collection type annotations remain the only author override.
features.resolution: Keep `i64` and `f64` as the fixed implicit scalar defaults, run numeric-only relation defaulting once after constraint solving, and require expression-local concrete list/dict context for empty collections.

features.title: Higher-Order Callable Polymorphism
features.syntax: No new source form selected; existing callable/value positions require an explicit semantic boundary.
features.resolution: Keep inferred schemes available only to direct named calls; any passed, stored, captured, or returned callable value must freeze to one concrete monomorphic function type.

features.title: Import Declaration
features.syntax: @import { pkg/module }
features.resolution: Open module import grammar with `@` and inspect `NAME("import")` only inside that symbol-headed family.

features.title: Inferred Callable Relation
features.syntax: # identity := (value) => value
features.resolution: Infer one principal rank-1 relation at each eligible final callable definition, generalize only at its definition boundary, and keep all type variables compiler-owned.

features.title: Infinite Loop
features.syntax: [...] >> ?(cond) => { ... } and infinite body forms
features.resolution: Represent an infinite pulse source with `[...]` and compose termination through the ordinary guard family.

features.title: Keyword-Free Lexical Contract
features.syntax: Every identifier-shaped word is tokenized as NAME; punctuation and surrounding structure select language forms.
features.resolution: Styio reserves no word token. Parsers may inspect an exact NAME spelling only after a symbol-anchored production has selected that context.

features.title: List Iterator
features.syntax: [items] >> #(item) => body
features.resolution: Use `>>` to advance an iterable one item at a time and push each item into a pulse closure.

features.title: Match Cases
features.resolution: Use `?=` for expression-oriented matching with explicit case arrows and `_` fallback.

features.title: Materialized Range
features.syntax: [start..end] and [start..end] >> #(item) => body; [start..end..step] is reserved
features.resolution: Keep naked `start..end` as the range expression and brackets as explicit materialization into a list source.

features.title: Monomorphic Callable Values
features.syntax: In type position, `#(T1, T2): R`; in value position, a bare final noncapturing callable name may coerce only under one complete concrete callable type.
features.resolution: Represent each named callable or concrete inferred instance as a distinct compiler-owned function item and coerce it contextually to an allocation-free monomorphic callable value; do not admit captures, generalized storage, address equality, or implicit signature guessing.

features.title: Persistent Callable Specialization Cache
features.syntax: No source form; cache location and retention are compiler operational configuration and cannot change program meaning.
features.resolution: Reuse verified native specialization artifacts by the existing full content digest in a compiler/target-namespaced local cache with atomic writes, corruption fallback, measured lookup cost, and explicit age/size/file-count pruning.

features.title: Portable Generic Body Interface
features.syntax: No new source form; this is a versioned compiler artifact split behind existing import/export syntax.
features.resolution: Publish a stable relation/effect/capability contract separately from a canonical typed StyioIR payload; consumers verify schema, semantic body, dependency, compiler, and target-independent digests before specialization.

features.title: Rank-2 Callback Polymorphism
features.syntax: No source `forall` or generic binder is selected; a future higher-order parameter may carry one compiler-owned generalized callback requirement.
features.resolution: Reserve bidirectional, context-checked rank-2 callback parameters as the only approved higher-rank direction; do not infer impredicative lists, dictionaries, fields, captures, or arbitrary generalized values.

features.title: Recursive Callable Group
features.syntax: A self-recursive or mutually recursive final callable component inferred as one dependency group.
features.resolution: Assign one provisional monotype to every SCC member, solve all internal edges against those monotypes, generalize at the group boundary, and reject any internal edge that needs a different instantiation.

features.title: Return And Export
features.syntax: <| expr and inline return value forms
features.resolution: Use symbolic continuation transfer for callable results without introducing a word-headed return statement.

features.title: Type Expression
features.syntax: T|n|, T|..n|, T.., T..., list[T], dict[K, V], and tuple types
features.resolution: Keep one type-position grammar for exact, recent-window, unbounded, collection-rewrite, and tuple shapes.

features.title: User-Extensible Callable Constraints
features.syntax: No constraint, trait, instance, implementation, priority, or orphan keyword/form is reserved.
features.resolution: Keep numeric, comparable, indexable, iterable, and cloneable compiler-owned; if reopened, consider only owner-local non-overlapping instances and reject orphan, overlap, priority, and import-order resolution.

features.title: Parser Shadow Cutover
features.syntax: nightly parser primary path with retained parser routes used only for explicit audit evidence
features.resolution: Keep the hand-written nightly compiler parser as the only accepted grammar authority and require zero accepted-grammar fallback.

features.title: File Resource Atom
features.syntax: @file("path") and @("path")
features.resolution: Construct a statically resolved file resource through the `@` resource family, with `@file("path")` and `@("path")` as accepted forms.

features.title: Resource Instant Pull
features.syntax: << @resource
features.resolution: Use prefix `<<` to request an immediate value from a readable resource without opening an iterator.

features.title: Resource Iterable Redirect
features.syntax: items >> @resource
features.resolution: Use `>> @resource` for per-item pulse emission from an iterable and keep `-> @resource` for one whole value.

features.title: Resource Method Definition
features.syntax: @family::name := () => { ... }
features.resolution: Bind resource-family methods and properties through `@family::name`, reusing ordinary binding finality while keeping receiver identity explicit.

features.title: Resource Selector Offset
features.syntax: resource selector offsets and ranges
features.resolution: Parse selector offsets as a bounded resource-specific subgrammar without changing ordinary index expression precedence.

features.title: Resource Selector Read
features.resolution: Read committed or block-snapshot resource state through explicit resource-object selectors.

features.title: Resource Sink Write
features.syntax: expr -> @resource
features.resolution: Use `->` for one value or whole-value serialization into a resource sink.

features.title: Resource Slot Declaration
features.syntax: @name : T|..n|
features.resolution: Use `@name` for visible resource identity and type-position shapes for bounded resource storage.

features.title: Standard Input Pull
features.syntax: value <- @stdin and typed tuple/list stdin pull
features.resolution: Bind one standard-input read through `<- @stdin`, using an explicit target type when scalar inference is insufficient.

features.title: Resource Zip Iterator
features.syntax: lhs >> #(a) & rhs >> #(b) => body
features.resolution: Use `&` between iterator sources as an aligned zip barrier that terminates with the shorter finite input.

features.title: Await Bind
features.syntax: ?| job -> value: T | fallback
features.resolution: Settle a task through the shared effect marker, bind its typed result, and keep fallback behavior explicit.

features.title: Task Group Launch
features.resolution: Launch a statically named group of tasks through one `||>` group expression with explicit task-handle bindings.

features.title: Task Resource Order
features.resolution: Use `=>` between task handles as an explicit happens-before edge, separate from value or resource transfer.

features.title: Single Task
features.resolution: Launch one task with `||>` and bind its explicit task handle through the ordinary mutable or final binding model.
